tasks.AbsoluteValues: Compute the absolute values of the differences obtained in the previous step.
tasks.CalculateMean: Calculate the mean of the given list of numbers.
tasks.DivideByCount: Divide the sum by the count of numbers to get the Mean Absolute Deviation.
tasks.SubtractMean: Subtract the calculated mean from each number in the list.
tasks.SumAbsoluteDifferences: Sum up all the absolute differences.
